item.title: Fluorine-Mediated Molten-Salt Crystallization Regulates Phase Evolution and Structural Stability in Sodium Layered Oxides
item.description:
سنتز مذاب-نمکی کمک‌شده با NaF در کاتدهای لایه‌ای P2 نوع Fe–Mn–Ti پنجره پایداری فاز P2 را گسترش داده و با کاهش ترک‌خوردگی، پایداری چرخه‌ای را بهبود می‌دهد.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 NaF-assisted molten-salt synthesis enables phase-selective growth of large-particle, Ni/Co-free P2 Fe–Mn–Ti cathodes, widening the P2 stability window and preserving layered ordering. This yields more reversible structural evolution, homogeneous Mn redox, and a surface-enriched fluorine gradient that suppresses cracking and improves cycling stability—offering a scalable route to durable sodium-ion cathodes.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · P2 layered oxide · molten-salt synthesis · fluorine doping · cathode stability

item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using LiI additive to kinetically control crystallization of a metastable orthorhombic phase, lowering the o-to-t transition temperature and accelerating its rate. Significance: reveals microstructural engineering of polymorphism in Ge-free LGPS-type electrolytes, clarifies iodine's role (forming Li4PS4I secondary phase), and demonstrates dual-phase materials enabling high-performance lithium–sulfur solid-state batteries.

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using iodine monochloride (ICl) as an in situ redox mediator, where I–Cl electronegativity difference creates an electrophilic Iδ+ center that strengthens Li2O2 interaction and lowers its decomposition barrier from 2.39 to 0.77 eV. This enables low polarization (0.52 V), suppresses parasitic reactions, and extends cycling beyond 800 h, offering a design principle for efficient Li–O2 batteries.
